purpose: photosperf1: Nord2Metal y2s85-photosperf = y2s83-thumbfix5 + (1) 'NORD2 PERF PHOTOS A/B/C' counters every 5 s in MobileSlideShow and backboardd (frames, submit->fence latency, commit CPU, YCbCr conversions, frozen hits, iosurface texture creation, allocations, compute-only commits); (2) MobileSlideShow: a frozen thumbnail gives back its planes import and odd-size padding picture; (3) MobileSlideShow: no Photos diagnostic read-backs (PHOTOS frame probe, cpu-view lock). Switches: /var/db/nord2-metal/no-photosperf (behaviour = thumbfix5, counters stay, opt=0), /var/db/nord2-metal/no-photosperf-log (no counter lines).
